title: Memory Controller
text: Arbitrate memory transactions for one or more Memory Channel blocks, 1 input, 1 output; {Hardware board} sets the view or modify current hardware settings Read-only: name of current hardware, {Memory selection} sets the between memory regions, {Number of masters}, {Interconnect arbitration} sets the arbitration policy Round, {Use hardware board settings} uses hardware implementation settings from the configuration, {Bandwidth}, {Frequency (MHz)} sets the controller clock frequency, in MHz, {Data width (bits)} sets the bit width of datapath, {Bandwidth derating (%)} sets the memory transaction inefficiencies 0-100, {Request to first transfer (in clocks)} sets the number of clock cycles between request and start of transfer nonnegative and {Last transfer to transaction complete (in clocks)} sets the number of clock cycles between the end of transfer and completion of transaction nonnegative. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Hardware board
params.values: View or modify current hardware settings Read-only: name of current hardware board

params.name: Memory selection
params.values: Choose between memory regions PS memory (default) | PL memory

params.name: Number of masters
params.values: Number of masters connected to this controller 2 (default) | positive integer from 1 to 12

params.name: Interconnect arbitration
params.values: Arbitration policy Round robin (default) | Fixed port priority

params.name: Use hardware board settings
params.values: Use hardware implementation settings from the configuration parameters off (default) | on

params.name: Bandwidth
params.values: Bandwidth for transactions towards external memory Read-only: scalar

params.name: Frequency (MHz)
params.values: Controller clock frequency, in MHz 200 (default) | scalar

params.name: Data width (bits)
params.values: Bit width of datapath 64 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Request to first transfer (in clocks)
params.values: Number of clock cycles between request and start of transfer nonnegative integer

params.name: Last transfer to transaction complete (in clocks)
params.values: Number of clock cycles between the end of transfer and completion of transaction nonnegative integer
